decisions.reason: Operator training builds directly on the firm's established training capability, costs little to keep offering, and supports machine sales, so the option is cheap to hold open.
The fourth rotary axis accessory complements the core milling machines at low carrying cost, and there is no evidence its value has failed to materialize.

Hybrid additive post-processing is distant from the core and only mentioned on the website, so its value is still highly uncertain, but it fits the firm's future-oriented direction in materials processing and remains a cheap growth option for now.
The high-speed CNC milling line is close to the core business, presented prominently with several models, and its value is largely confirmed, so it warrants continued commitment.
The automatic tool change system is an integral, separately presented extension of the machine offer that raises customer productivity, so dropping it would forgo value at little saving.
